title.zh: 欧盟将 Circle 发行的 USDC 认定为首个“重要”电子货币代币，Circle 欧洲赎回政策允许临时延迟
title.en: Circle can delay European USDC redemptions if reserves cannot cross borders

current_state.zh: 欧洲银行管理局依据 MiCA 将 Circle 的 USDC 归类为“重要电子货币代币”，使这枚 730 亿美元的稳定币接受欧盟与法国联合监管，并面临更严格的合规要求。
current_state.en: The European Banking Authority classified Circle's USDC as a 'significant e-money token' under MiCA, placing the $73 billion stablecoin under joint EU and French supervisory oversight with heightened compliance requirements.

updates.title_zh: 若储备无法跨境转移，Circle 可延迟欧洲 USDC 赎回
updates.title_en: Circle can delay European USDC redemptions if reserves cannot cross borders
updates.what_changed_zh: Circle 的欧洲 USDC 赎回政策允许在其法国与美国发行方之间无法转移储备时临时延迟赎回，这为欧洲经济区持有者带来潜在的现金获取边界，尽管他们享有按面值赎回的权利。
updates.what_changed_en: Circle's European USDC redemption policy permits temporary delays if reserves cannot move between its French and U.S. issuers, creating a potential cash-access boundary for EEA holders despite their par-value redemption right.

updates.title_zh: USDC被列为欧盟首个「重要电子货币代币」
updates.title_en: USDC被列为欧盟首个「重要电子货币代币」
updates.what_changed_zh: 欧洲银行管理局将 Circle 发行的 USDC 指定为欧盟首个 MiCA 下的“重要”电子货币代币，自 2026 年 11 月 12 日起，将其资本、储备、流动性及恢复/赎回计划的直接监管权从法国 ACPR 移交至 EBA，并配套签署新的 EBA–NYDFS 合作备忘录。
updates.what_changed_en: The European Banking Authority designated Circle-issued USDC as the EU's first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, transferring direct supervision of its capital, reserves, liquidity and recovery/redemption plans to the EBA from France's ACPR starting 12 November 2026, and paired with a new EBA–NYDFS cooperation memorandum.
